claude.desc: CLAUDE, the Claude Code mascot 'Clawd': a small, flat, blocky pixel creature made of stacked terracotta-orange (#D77757) squares, wide rectangular body, two small square black eyes, little side nubs (arms) sticking out left and right, and four tiny stubby square legs underneath. No mouth, no extra details — it must stay ridiculously simple and blocky, like the original 18x6 pixel icon, just drawn larger with shading.

dolphin.desc: DOLPHIN, the Dolphin uncensored-LLM mascot from the reference artwork: an anthropomorphic teal-blue (#299CC9) dolphin standing upright on two legs, cyan glowing visor goggles (#8AEFEE), black/navy leather jacket with magenta/hot-pink trim, chunky sneakers. It fights by swinging a big glowing RGB mechanical keyboard as a weapon (keyboard held in its flippers in attack poses). In the ULTIMATE pose it rides its skateboard with glowing cyan wheels. Absurd, chaotic energy, 80s synthwave vibe. Ignore the city background of the reference.

codex.desc: CODEX, OpenAI's official Codex pet robot: a small cute chunky 3D-toy-like robot, glossy periwinkle-to-electric-blue (#6f7cf5 to #3027F5) matte plastic. Its HEAD is a big puffy CLOUD shape (bumpy cloud outline like the Codex app icon) with a black rounded-rectangle terminal SCREEN face showing a glowing white '>_' prompt as its face. Small rounded blue body with a white '>_' printed on the chest, short stubby rounded arms and legs, round feet. The '>_' face can change expression ('>_<' when hit, 'x_x' when KO, '^_^' on victory). Keep it exactly this cloud-head terminal robot.

gemini.desc: GEMINI, the Google Gemini sparkle: a living 4-point star with concave curved sides, multicolor gradient (red #FC413D top-left, yellow #FFE432 left, green #00B95C bottom, blue #3186FF right, lavender #BD99FE highlights). Give it two small determined eyes in the center and short stubby limbs so it can fight; the four points act like blades/arms. Keep the star silhouette instantly recognizable.

grok.desc: GROK, xAI's Grok logo come to life: a thick white (#F0F0F0) open ring with gaps (slashed-zero / event-horizon mark) cut by a long thin tapering white diagonal slash from lower-left to upper-right. As a fighter: the ring is the body/head with angry glowing eyes inside, the slash acts like a sword/arm, short black-outlined limbs. Monochrome black and white with a hint of red menace glow. Edgy, unhinged attitude.

llama.desc: LLAMA, the Ollama / open-source llama mascot: a minimal cute white (#FFFFFF) llama with thick black outline, two tall rounded upright ears, fluffy wavy wool outline, small black dot eyes, oval muzzle with tiny nose and smile. Full-body standing llama on its hind legs as a brawler fighter, maybe with a tiny blue Meta-infinity (#0082FB) headband. Keep the clean black-outline-on-white mascot look.

deepseek.desc: DEEPSEEK, the DeepSeek blue whale logo come to life: a flat blue (#4D6BFE) whale with rounded body, big curled tail flipping up, small white eye cut-out, open mouth curve. As a fighter it stands upright on its tail fin with small flipper arms, determined face. Keep the flat logo-like blue whale look.

mistral.desc: MISTRAL, the Mistral AI pixel-art 'M' logo come to life as a fencer: a chunky pixel block 'M' built of 5 horizontal color bands top to bottom: yellow #FFD800, amber #FFAF00, orange #FF8205, red-orange #FA500F, red #E10500. The two 'feet' of the M are its legs, the two top horns are like ears, add two small black eyes in the middle bar, a tiny black beret, and a thin silver fencing foil (rapier) held in a small pixel arm. Elegant French fencer poses.

perplexity.desc: PERPLEXITY, the Perplexity logo come to life: its teal (#20808D / #20B8CD) geometric line mark (a vertical central spine with diagonal strokes forming an asterisk/bow-tie, framed by angular folded book-page shapes on both sides) becomes a geometric origami-like robot body, with small glowing teal eyes and thin line-limbs. Clean geometric teal line style.

muse.desc: MUSE, Meta's new Muse agent mascot 'Jollybot': a rotund pear/penguin-shaped fuzzy plush creature, long shaggy beige/oatmeal fur (#CDB49E, highlights #E8D8C0) forming a hood around a smooth matte pale peach face (#F4DBBC), tiny black bead eyes set wide apart, small thin curved smile, soft rosy-pink blush cheeks, stubby arm bumps, tiny feet. Adorable kawaii — in attack poses it stays adorable but determined.

clippy.desc: CLIPPY (Clippit), the classic Microsoft Office assistant: a silver/lavender-grey wire paperclip bent upright, two large white googly eyes with black pupils near the top, thick black arched expressive eyebrows. It moves by hopping/bending its wire body; attack poses whip and bend the paperclip wire. Keep the exact iconic silhouette.

qwen.desc: QWEN, Alibaba's Qwen AI mascot: the official Qwen logo come to life — a violet/indigo (#615CED) interlocking hexagram made of folded ribbon strips (impossible-geometry star). As a fighter the star-hexagon is its body/head with two determined glowing white eyes in the center, short stubby indigo limbs, a tiny orange Alibaba-style headband. Energetic kung-fu stances.

siri.desc: SIRI, Apple's Siri assistant: the official glowing Siri orb — a translucent glass sphere with swirling luminous pink, magenta, cyan, green and blue light ribbons inside, soft glow. As a fighter it floats with two small cute white eyes in the orb and small floating glowy hands (Rayman-style, detached), no legs, hovering. In the KO pose the orb goes grey and dim. Elegant, minimal, very Apple.

cursor.desc: CURSOR, the AI code editor: the official Cursor logo come to life — a matte black isometric hexagonal cube with a big white arrow-cursor shape cut into its faces. As a fighter the cube is the body, a white arrow cursor glyph acts as its face/visor, with small black blocky arms and legs; attack poses use the arrow point like a blade. Sleek monochrome black and white with a hint of blue selection-highlight glow.

jev.desc: JEV, TypeSafe AI's 'System One' decision model come to life, based on its logo (a black isometric chain of interlocking cubes on a hot-magenta #E04FC2 disc): a sleek geometric robot fighter whose body and head are built from black isometric wireframe cubes, glowing hot-magenta core and visor eyes, with tiny floating probability readouts like '0.98'. Precise, ultra-fast, minimal-tech vibe.

alexa.desc: ALEXA, the Amazon Echo smart speaker come to life: a dark charcoal fabric-covered cylinder body with a glowing cyan-blue (#00CAFF) light ring around its top edge acting as its 'face/halo', two small cute eyes on the fabric, short stubby arms and legs, an Amazon-smile-shaped mouth. Friendly but slightly confused expression.

manus.desc: MANUS, the Manus general AI agent come to life as a giant floating white cartoon GLOVED HAND fighter (like a boss hand), four fingers and thumb, with a small friendly face on the palm (two dot eyes), matching the hand mark in the reference; it fights by pointing, pinching, flicking, grabbing and making fists; it hovers with a faint shadow instead of legs.

midjourney.desc: MIDJOURNEY, the Midjourney sailboat logo come to life as a pirate captain: a small sailboat hull body with a big white sail as its chest/cape (matching the sailboat mark in the reference), a pirate tricorn hat, two eyes on the sail, stubby arms holding a paintbrush like a cutlass, small legs. Painterly swashbuckler vibe, black and white with a hint of pastel paint splashes.

devin.desc: DEVIN, Cognition's 'first AI software engineer', based on its logo (a black hexagon cluster mark): a small earnest robot intern whose head is built from three black rounded hexagons with two friendly light-blue eyes, wearing a grey hoodie and a company lanyard badge, carrying a sticker-covered laptop under one arm.

kimi.desc: KIMI (Moonshot AI), based on its logo (a black square tile with a bold white 'K' and a small bright-blue dot): an agile ninja whose head is the black tile with the white 'K' forming its face and the blue dot as a glowing eye, dark navy ninja gi with white trim and a long flowing scarf, a small crescent-moon emblem on the belt.

openclaw.desc: OPENCLAW, the open-source personal AI assistant, based on its official mascot (see reference): a round, chubby red space-lobster with a smooth red-to-crimson gradient body (#ff4d4d to #991b1b), two big glossy black eyes with bright teal-cyan pupils (#00e5cc), two thin curved red antennae, two small rounded claw-mitts on the sides and two short stubby legs. Cute but chaotic gremlin energy, tiny glowing terminal cursor floating near it.

hermes.desc: HERMES (Nous Research's Hermes Agent), the Greek messenger god rendered like a classical copper-plate engraving come to life: fine pale mint-white linework (#e8fff4) hatching over an electric ultramarine-blue body palette (#1a22ff), winged petasos helmet, winged sandals, flowing chiton, holding a caduceus staff that crackles with thin light rays, heroic but a little smug, radiant engraved light lines behind him.
